Build error fixed. Here's what happened and what I did:

## Root Cause
The Metro bundler crashed on `@ai-sdk/react`'s nested copy of `@ai-sdk/provider-utils` (v3.0.32), which contains a dynamic `import(id)` call that Hermes/Metro cannot compile. The existing postinstall patch only targeted one file and didn't survive the last dependency reinstall.

## Fix
- **Rewrote `expo/scripts/patch-ai-sdk-provider-utils.mjs`** — it now scans all of `node_modules` (including nested copies) and patches every `@ai-sdk/provider-utils` copy, both `index.mjs` and `index.js`
- **Ran the patch** — found 3 copies, patched the 2 unsafe files in the nested `@ai-sdk/react` copy
- **Verified** — zero unsafe `import(id)` calls remain; `runChecks` passes with 0 errors
- **Pushed to GitHub** — commit `a6114ce2b110` on `main`, so the fix survives future installs via the postinstall hook

The preview should bundle cleanly now — iOS, Android, and Web were all failing on the same transform error, and all three are unblocked.
